summary: The verified source contract permits at most 10 tree nodes, which is too small for an honest runtime-scaling verdict across multiple legal tiers.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The source-fidelity-verified constraint bounds the tree between 0 and 10 nodes, inclusive.

replacement_checks.evidence: The loop advances once along each node of the original left spine. The structural guarantee makes every other node a right leaf attached to a spine node, so all n nodes are covered by O(n) pointer work and only a fixed number of references are stored.
Black-box real-test execution verifies every existing ordinary check without inspecting its definition, including the app-local tree conversion and result serialization path.
